description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Amumu''' reduces every instance of pre-mitigation physical damage taken, capped at 50% of the damage instance.
description.text: Passive: Amumu reduces every instance of pre-mitigation physical damage taken, capped at 50% of the damage instance.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Amumu''' releases his anger, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
description2.text: Active: Amumu releases his anger, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

description3.raw: ''Tantrum's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] '''current''' cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds whenever '''Amumu''' is hit by a [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]].
description3.text: Tantrum's  current cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds whenever Amumu is hit by a basic attack on-hit.

notes.raw: * A [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]]'s [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]] and each [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effect are all separate damage instances, and may be reduced each if they deal physical damage. * ''Tantrum's'' cooldown reduction will trigger multiple times for effects such as [[File:Master Yi Double Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Master Yi#Double Strike|An icon for Master Yi's ability Double Strike]] [[Master Yi#Double Strike|Double Strike]] and [[File:Guinsoo's Rageblade item.png|20xpx|border|link=Guinsoo's Rageblade|An icon for the item Guinsoo's Rageblade]] [[Guinsoo's Rageblade|Guinsoo's Rageblade's]] ''Phantom Hit''. ** The cooldown will be reduced, even if the incoming attack is [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]]. ** The cooldown will not be reduced, if the incoming attack misses due to the enemy being [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
A basic attack's basic damage and each on-hit effect are all separate damage instances, and may be reduced each if they deal physical damage.
Tantrum's cooldown reduction will trigger multiple times for effects such as Double Strike and Guinsoo's Rageblade's Phantom Hit.
* The cooldown will be reduced, even if the incoming attack is blocked.
* The cooldown will not be reduced, if the incoming attack misses due to the enemy being blinded.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
